items.source: destinationName - the name of the destination
items.translation: destinationName - 目的地的名称

items.source: Note that the fallback to resolution of dynamic destinations is turned off by default. Switch the "fallbackToDynamicDestination" flag on to enable this functionality.
items.translation: 请注意，动态目标解析的降级功能默认处于关闭状态。请开启"fallbackToDynamicDestination"标志以启用此功能。

items.source: Dynamic queues and topics get cached by destination name. As a consequence, you need to use unique destination names across both queues and topics. Caching can be turned off through the "cache" flag.
items.translation: 动态队列和主题按目标名称进行缓存。因此，您需要在队列和主题之间使用唯一的目标名称。可以通过 `"cache"` 标志关闭缓存。

items.source: The default is Spring's standard DynamicDestinationResolver.
items.translation: 默认值为 Spring 的标准的DynamicDestinationResolver。

items.source:
Allows for customizing the JNDI environment if necessary, for example
specifying appropriate JNDI environment properties.
items.translation: 允许在必要时自定义 JNDI 环境，例如指定适当的 JNDI 环境属性。

items.source:
This flag can be turned off to re-lookup a destination for each operation,
which allows for hot restarting of destinations. This is mainly useful
during development.
items.translation: 此标志可关闭，以便为每个操作重新查找目的地，从而允许对目的地进行热重启。这在开发期间特别有用。

items.source:
Note that dynamic queues and topics get cached by destination name.
As a consequence, you need to use unique destination names across both
queues and topics.
items.translation: 请注意，动态队列和主题会按目标名称进行缓存。因此，您需要在队列和主题之间使用唯一的目标名称。

items.source: Turn this flag on to enable transparent fallback to dynamic destinations.
items.translation: 打开此标志以启用对动态目标的透明回退。

items.source: Set the DestinationResolver to use when falling back to dynamic destinations.
items.translation: 设置用于回退到动态目标时的DestinationResolver。

items.source:
Resolve the given destination name, either as located resource
or as dynamic destination.
items.translation: 解析给定的目标名称，将其作为位于资源或动态目标。

items.source:
Validate the given Destination object, checking whether it matches
the expected type.
items.translation: 验证给定的 Destination 对象，检查其是否与预期类型匹配。

items.source: pubSubDomain - true if a Topic is expected, false in case of a Queue
items.translation: pubSubDomain - 如果预期为 Topic，则为 true；如果是 Queue，则为 false。

items.source: destination - the Destination object to validate
items.translation: destination - 要验证的 Destination 对象

items.source:
To be called if access to the specified destination failed,
assuming that the JMS Destination object might have become invalid.
items.translation: 如果访问指定的目标失败，且假设 JMS 目标对象可能已失效，则应调用此方法。

items.source: To be called in case of general JMS provider failure.
items.translation: 在发生通用 JMS 提供者故障时调用。

items.translation: 描述从接口复制：DestinationResolver

items.source: Clear the entire destination cache.
items.translation: 清除整个目标缓存。

items.source:
Remove the destination with the given name from the cache
(if cached by this resolver in the first place).
items.translation: 从缓存中删除给定名称的目的地（如果最初是由此解析器缓存的）。

items.source: Set whether to cache resolved destinations.
items.translation: 设置是否缓存解析后的目标。

items.source:
Set whether this resolver is supposed to create dynamic destinations
if the destination name is not found in JNDI.
items.translation: 设置此解析器是否应在 JNDI 中未找到目标名称时创建动态目标。

items.translation: `resolveDestinationName` 接口 `DestinationResolver` 中

items.source: pubSubDomain - true if the domain is pub-sub, false if P2P
items.translation: pubSubDomain - 如果该域为发布订阅模式则为 true，否则为 false（即 P2P）。

items.source: session - the current JMS Session (may be null if the resolver implementation is able to work without it)
items.translation: session - 当前的 JMS Session（如果解析器实现无需它即可工作，则可能为 null）

items.source: jakarta.jms.JMSException - if the JMS Session failed to resolve the destination
items.translation: jakarta.jms.JMSException - 如果 JMS Session 无法解析目标。
